title: V25 self-review: capacity gate belongs only at new-intent publication boundary
finding: The first V25 overlay placed a server-side require_provider_intent_capacity() precheck before replay/intent resolution. At exactly the unresolved-intent limit that would incorrectly block a safe exact durable replay and an already-matching unresolved-intent retry, neither of which creates another tombstone.
correction: Do not add a generic server precheck.
Enforce MAX_UNRESOLVED_PROVIDER_INTENTS only inside the V22 strict mark-intent transaction, after exact replay and existing-inflight checks and immediately before staging a genuinely new inflight_fp.
General cleanup still preserves unresolved intents before ordinary TTL/LRU eviction.
A loaded state already over the limit remains preserved; new provider intents fail closed until explicit reconciliation reduces ambiguity.
